uncited: It is distinguished from its siblings by its strict one-to-one brick-to-node mapping and per-channel traversal requirements, which contrast with the residency-optimized caching of [Residency Octree Traversal](3073-residency-octree-traversal.md) or the specialized wavelet leaves of [Octree-based Volume Rendering with Wavelet Leaves](6683-octree-based-volume-rendering-with-wavelet-leaves.md).
**Inputs:** Volumetric dataset (bricked), camera parameters (position, field-of-view), transfer functions.
**Traversal Initialization:** Start traversal at the third level of the octree.
*   **Chamberlain's Criterion:** Compute the projected size of the octree node on the fly.
**Field-of-View:** Discard nodes that do not intersect the view frustum.
*   **Projection Threshold:** Predefined threshold for Chamberlain's criterion.
*   **FOV Angle:** Field-of-view angle of the camera.
*   **Memory Overhead:** Rendering high-resolution regions requires entire subtrees to be resident in cache.
*   **Time Complexity:** Depends on the sparsity of the volume and the efficiency of the traversal.
